name: Segment
description: A circular segment: the pie cut, then trimmed square across the chord.

code.style: --rule: ( --from: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 150deg, transparent 150deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from @var(--from) at 50% 50%, #000 0 150deg, transparent 150deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
